selection: Mean of positive-class and negative-class validation Brier scores; every 10 epochs; held-out two-crown geometries
notes: Source duration is an explicit input (10/20/30 seconds). Confirmation uses 20 seconds. Require 12 or more 20-second training cases and three positive geometries at that duration. Older 30-second evidence is reusable development context, not interchangeable exposure. Five optimization seeds; no hyperparameter search.
